title: Celestial Sun and Moon Faces
description: A surreal painting depicts a large orange sun with a closed-eyed feminine face on the left, merging with a purple-toned woman's profile on the right wearing an ornate headpiece with leaves. Melting drips flow downward from where their faces meet, set against a cosmic background with a glowing red sunburst, starry night sky, pine forest, and ethereal green and purple smoke.
prompt: Surreal psychedelic painting of a glowing orange sun with a serene closed-eyed feminine face merging into a purple cosmic woman's profile, their faces melting and dripping where they connect. She wears an intricate leafy headband and beads. Background shows a starry night sky, red solar burst, misty green smoke, pine forest silhouette, and reflective water, in a vibrant dreamlike style with flowing ethereal colors.
